jsonld.description: Custom carpentry and cabinetry company in Homestead, FL: TV walls, kitchens, closets, home offices and built-in wood furniture made to measure.

parrafo.es: Miami Custom Wood & Design LLC diseña y construye muebles y carpintería a medida en Homestead: paredes de TV, cocinas, closets y oficinas en casa. Cada pieza se fabrica a la medida exacta de tu espacio, con un trato directo de principio a fin.
parrafo.en: Miami Custom Wood & Design LLC designs and builds custom furniture and cabinetry in Homestead: TV walls, kitchens, closets and home offices. Every piece is built to the exact measurements of your space, with direct communication from start to finish.

hero.imagen_alt: Pared de TV en madera a medida construida por Miami Custom Wood & Design

parrafo_1.es: Miami Custom Wood & Design LLC es un taller de carpintería local con base en Homestead, dirigido por Víctor. Diseñamos y fabricamos muebles y carpintería a medida: paredes de entretenimiento, cocinas, closets, oficinas en casa y piezas de acento, pensadas desde cero para el espacio exacto de cada cliente.
parrafo_1.en: Miami Custom Wood & Design LLC is a local carpentry workshop based in Homestead, led by Víctor. We design and build custom furniture and cabinetry: entertainment walls, kitchens, closets, home offices and accent pieces, planned from scratch for each client's exact space.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes repiten lo mismo: confianza, atención a cada detalle del diseño y una calidad de madera e instalación que se nota de inmediato.
parrafo_2.en: Our clients say the same thing again and again: trust, attention to every detail of the design, and a quality of wood and installation that shows right away.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué mueble o espacio quieres transformar: cocina, closet, pared de TV u oficina. Respondemos directo, sin intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us which piece or space you want to transform: kitchen, closet, TV wall or home office. We reply directly, no middlemen.

texto.es: Visitamos tu casa, tomamos medidas exactas y diseñamos la pieza según tu espacio y tu estilo.
texto.en: We visit your home, take exact measurements, and design the piece around your space and your style.

texto.es: Construimos cada pieza en taller con materiales de calidad y terminaciones cuidadas al detalle.
texto.en: We build every piece in our workshop with quality materials and finishes handled down to the smallest detail.

texto.es: Instalamos con precisión, revisamos el resultado contigo y dejamos el área lista para usar.
texto.en: We install with precision, walk the finished result with you, and leave the area ready to use.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el diseño, el material y las medidas. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on the design, material and measurements. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Centros de entretenimiento a medida en madera, con repisas, iluminación y paneles de acento diseñados para tu sala.
texto.en: Custom wood entertainment centers with shelving, lighting and accent panels designed around your living room.

texto.es: Gabinetes, islas y repisas de cocina fabricados a medida, con herrajes de calidad y acabados duraderos.
texto.en: Cabinets, islands and kitchen shelving built to measure, with quality hardware and durable finishes.

texto.es: Closets y muebles de guardado diseñados para aprovechar cada centímetro disponible de tu casa.
texto.en: Closets and storage furniture designed to make the most of every inch of your home.

texto.es: Escritorios y oficinas en casa con repisas integradas, iluminación y diseño pensado para tu rutina de trabajo.
texto.en: Desks and home offices with built-in shelving, lighting and a layout designed around your workday.

pie.es: ¿Tu proyecto es distinto? Llámanos igual: trabajamos la mayoría de muebles y carpintería interior a medida.
pie.en: Is your project different? Call us anyway: we build most custom furniture and interior carpentry.

items.quote: Miami Custom Wood does an amazing job! They do incredible work and can bring any idea you have to life. Whatever you imagine, they can make it happen! Great quality, excellent attention to detail, and very professional service. Highly recommended! You won't be disappointed!
Victor helped us design and build our living room bookshelf. We are so happy with the end product. He was super professional. Highly recommended.

Professionalism and impeccable service. What I appreciate most about Miami Custom Wood & Design is the trust they inspire. The owner, Victor, is a very kind, polite, and responsible person. He was very attentive to every detail of our design and exceeded our expectations. The quality of the wood and the precision of the installation demonstrate his excellent work.

texto.en: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 6 PM. Saturday, 8 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday.
